name: Histogram
summary: Binned distribution of one metric with automatic nice bins, optional density curve, median / mean lines, the target's bin highlighted and a rug of observations.
summary_zh: 单一指标的分箱分布：自动取整的组距、可选核密度曲线、中位数/均值线、目标所在组高亮及观测值地毯线。
description_zh: 把一列数值（如可比公司 EV/EBITDA、先例交易 30 日溢价）分组计数，柱高为个数或占比。组距可指定组数、组宽，或按 Freedman–Diaconis 规则自动计算并取整到 1/2/2.5/5 的整数倍，坐标刻度正好落在组边界上。虚线标出中位数和均值，强调色标出目标公司（或报价溢价等指定值）所在的组及其精确位置；可叠加高斯核密度曲线，横轴下方的地毯线显示每个观测值，悬停可看公司名称。点击某个柱子会以“区间”条件交叉筛选同页其他图表。
best_for: Distribution of peer multiples with the target positioned
Precedent premium ranges (where does the offer premium sit?)
avoid_when: Fewer than ~8 observations (show the points: scatter / bar)

value.desc: Metric to bin (null values are excluded and counted in the n note)

label.desc: Short label listed in bin tooltips and on rug hover

name.desc: Full name for the rug tooltip title

target.desc: Rows where this field is true are marked as the target

bins.desc: Approximate number of bins (rounded to a nice width); null = automatic (Freedman–Diaconis)

binStart.desc: First bin edge (default: the width multiple just below the minimum)

density.desc: Gaussian kernel density curve scaled to the bars

bandwidth.desc: KDE bandwidth (default: Silverman's rule of thumb)

targetValue.desc: Explicit value to mark (e.g. proposed offer premium); default: the target row's value

targetLabel.desc: Label of the target marker (default: target label + value)

highlight.desc: Label / name value(s) treated as the target; default uses the target channel

rug.desc: One tick per observation under the axis (hover for the name)

format.desc: Value format (defaults to the value field format)

title.desc: X axis title (defaults to the value field title)

interactions: Hover a bin for its range, count, share and the names inside
Hover a rug tick for the observation
Click a bin to cross-filter other blocks to that value range (click again to clear)

samples.title: Precedent premiums to 30-day VWAP vs. proposed offer
